title: Crypto advocates join in suing Illinois over digital asset tax
summary: The Crypto Council for Innovation and the Blockchain Association added another lawsuit against the state for its recently approved 0.2% crypto tax.

title: Pass the Clarity Act
summary: Reopening a settled provision four weeks before a vote would sink the bill, argues Summer Mersinger, CEO of the Blockchain Association.

title: Ethena's ENA token surges 48%, but altcoin season will have to wait
summary: ENA is rallying on a $1 billion FalconX deal, while HYPE tests its record, though flat dominance shows this is no broad alt season.

title: Coldcard ships firmware after $114 million bitcoin theft; says AI helped catch more bugs
summary: Three weeks of review turned up problems unrelated to the flaw that cost users $114 million, but updating still does not make a compromised wallet safe.

title: Analysts split on whether Bitcoin's surge past key levels signals a new bull run
summary: Market watchers say sudden sharp price spikes and forced short liquidations are the classic signs of a bottom, though macro risks still remain.
